title: Hazel and the Scholarship
author: Isandro Oyelaran
blurb: Theo Okafor, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
